elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Someone calls and your Mac and iPad ring along with your phone?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn off calls on your other devices.

[friendly] Open Settings, Apps, then Phone. Tap Calls on Other Devices. Switch off your Mac, or turn the whole thing off.

[delighted] Now only your phone rings, and the Mac stays quiet.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
